<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant [M+H]+ peak at m/z 127.0997. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~126.0924 Da. Fitting this mass with the isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1, indicating ~7 carbons) yields the formula C₇H₁₂NO, whose calculated [M+H]+ mass (127.0992 Da) matches the observed value within experimental error.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12NO</final_answer>
